<!--
  HOW TO ADD A PLAYLIST
  1. Open the playlist on YouTube. The URL looks like:
       https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
  2. Copy the part after "list=" (starts with PL).
  3. In a block below, replace PLAYLIST_ID_HERE with it (in BOTH places)
     and replace the title/description.
  4. Copy a whole block to add more playlists.
-->
